reports.author: John Rapp
reports.story:
I spent October 21, 2026 on Bluestone Lake - Bull Falls — Bull Falls Put in south towards Buffalo Creek from 8:53 AM to 5:25 PM with Austin Lilly and John Gillespie. I was fishing in sunny weather and clear water. I caught 23 fish, including smallmouth, with the largest measuring 16 inches.

Before the trip: typical checklist of items loaded into the truck the night before... paddle, PFD, batteries, Motor, Poles, Baits and electronics.

My approach was Ned rig and Stickbait / Senko around rocks / boulders, ledges / drops, and riffles. My productive baits and colors were Black with blue flake Gobey and TRD. Beautiful day at Bull Falls.

I fished from my Jackson BigRig, carrying 4 rod-and-reel setups. 4  (3) Cashion (1) St Croix. My setup included a motor (New Port NK300). For battery power, I used ZPro 36v 55Ah. Jackson Kayak Big Rig outfitted with a New Port NK300 powered by a ZPro 36 V 55ah battery.. l had my bending branches paddle.  I recorded my on the water action with a Insta360 4K camera.

What worked: Love Fishing from the comfort of what my set up offers with my Big Rig and motor..

What did not go to plan: Towards the end of the trip my steering on my NK300 loosened, which made it hard to steer... when I got back to the ramp, I noticed it had moved off center about 45 degrees.

My best five came to 73.50 inches, with a 16-incher leading the way. The other recorded measurements included a 15.5, a 14.25, a 14, and a 13.75.

reports.author: John Rapp
reports.story:
I spent October 10, 2026 on Bluestone Lake - Bull Falls — Bull Falls Put in south towards Buffalo Creek from 7:30 AM to 1:30 PM with Austin Lilly. I was fishing in overcast and drizzle weather and clear water. I caught 30 fish, including smallmouth, with the largest measuring 14 inches.

My approach was Ned rig and Stickbait / Senko around rocks / boulders and vegetation. My productive baits and colors were Hot Snakes TRD on a Ned Rig. I worked Ned rig and Stickbait / Senko around rocks / boulders, ledges / drops, and vegetation. My
productive baits and colors were Light-green Senkos around vegetation and Ned rigs with the Hot
Snake color around main-water rocks and ledges were my main approach. What I used was Hot
Snakes on a 3/18-ounce mushroom-head Ned rig. I probably landed more than half my fish with this, as
I was throwing it out into water in depths of 2-10 feet with hard, rocky bottoms in the swifter water
areas. Where I found grass in 2 to 4 feet areas, I threw a Gary Yamamoto Senko. 3-inch in Baby bass
and caught several this way. I had good numbers, but the quality size wasn't there. My partner, Austin
Lilly fared better using a green Chartreuse fluke and caught several fish over 16 inches. Something to
note about this time of year about Bull Falls is the shad run. We observed several pods/ balls of shad and
also observed several sizeable 5-10 lbs catfish and striped bass following.

I fished from my Feelfree Moken 10, carrying 4 rod-and-reel setups. My setup included a motor. I fished from my Feelfree Moken 10, carrying 4 rod-and-reel setups. Rods are Cashion and St. Crois.
Reels Spinning a Fluegar President and Kast King Baitcaster speedreel. My setup included a motor
(Bixpy J2). For battery power, I used Stock Bixpy Battery. used my BixpyJ2 motor, captured video with
my Insta360 4K, Bending Branches paddle, carried 4 poles, 3 spinning and one bait casters...

Next trip, I plan to try I wil take  my Jackson Big Rig.

My best five came to 66.75 inches, with a 14-incher leading the way on a Texas-rigged Baby Bass Senko. That same setup added a 13.25-inch fish, while a Ned rig with a Hot Snakes TRD brought in a 13.5 and a pair of 13s. Both baits did their part, but the Senko got the biggest bite of the day.

reports.author: John Rapp
reports.story:
Kayak, tackle, and another fishing story: New River — Brooks Fall to Sandstone Falls on October 7, 2026 from 7:30 AM to 11:30 AM with Austin Lilly and Greg Nahodil. I was fishing in sunny weather and clear water. I caught 25 fish, including smallmouth, with the largest measuring 17 inches.

My approach was Ned rig and Stickbait / Senko around ledges / drops and current seams. My productive baits and colors were Ned Rig Black with Blue Glitter TRD. Flowing water seemed to be the ticket off the ledges and rocks after faster flows mixed with neds and senkos.

I fished from my Feelfree Kayaks Moken 10, carrying 4 rod-and-reel setups. My setup included a motor. I used the my FeelFree Moken 10 with my Bixpy J2 motor. I had my Insta360 camera for recording. The float was about 3 1/2 miles. A lot of rock with some grass patches, plus swift shoals with a few rapids and around those points seemed like those were the most successful catching locations. There was not much success in Stillwater.

Next trip, I plan to try Read water better when navigating rapids.

My best five put 73.50 inches in the journal, with a 17-incher taking top billing on a Senko, black with blue glitter. A Ned rig TRD black with blue glitter joined the lineup with a 14.5, a 14.25, a 14, and a 13.75. A little variety earned its place in this fishing story.

reports.author: Heath Mullins
reports.story: I fished New river on 2026-08-15. I finished with 14 fish. My best measured fish totaled 95.75 inches. I started the day working a 130 plopper across current seams that held ledges anywhere from a foot to 5’ of water the patter was they were set up at the head of the seam right before the push water waiting to ambush caught several fish doing this early in the day and later in the day I would work the Chatterbait like a yoyo in the fastest rapids with drop offs in them and that’s how I caught the biggest fish of the day along with several others 7’3 Denali Dle rod mh mod for the plopper with 40 braid and 7,3 mh mod fast denali attax pro with 17 lb fluro
